lane:
هجب

هَجَبَ 1 , aor. ﹹ, inf. n. هَجْبٌ, _He drove,_ or _urged along._ (K.) === Also, _He beat with a stick,_ or _staff._ (K.) === Also, هَجَبَ, inf. n. as above, _He was quick,_ or _swift,_ (K,) _in his pace &c._ (TA.) === This art. is omitted by most of the lexicographers, because not regarded by them as of established authority. (TA.)
